SpaceKnife 读文件时不改访问时间；系统不允许时跳过还是照读: SpaceKnife reads files without changing their access time; when the system does not allow that, skip them or read them anyway
Windows、Program Files、ProgramData 等；其中的文: Windows, Program Files, ProgramData and the like; files there are only ever kept, never preselected for deletion
两个文件夹里有多组相同的文件时，保留的都在同一个文件夹里，删完另一个可以整个清空: When two folders share several identical files, the copies kept are all in the same folder, so the other one can be emptied
云占位文件（读取内容会触发下载，没有比较）: Cloud placeholder (reading it would download it; not compared)
保留不了访问时间的文件: Files whose access time cannot be kept
保留的那份变了或不在了，这一组没有动: The copy kept changed or is gone; this group was left alone
保留的那份正被别的程序打开（可能在改写），这一组没有动: The copy kept is open in another program (it may be writing to it); this group was left alone
删除前重读内容: Read the contents again before deleting
另有硬链接不在扫描里，删了不腾空间: It has hard links outside the scan: deleting it frees nothing
只读和别的文件大小相同的文件；读完全文、内容一致才算重复: Only files that share their size with another are read; files count as duplicates only once their whole contents match
同一对文件夹留在同一边: Keep copies on the same side of a folder pair
名字不能用于系统调用: Its name cannot be passed to the system
名字以点或空格结尾，删除篮删不了: Its name ends in a dot or a space: the delete basket cannot delete it
和同一对文件夹里的其他组留在同一边: Kept on the same side as the other groups of this folder pair
已经有一次查找在进行；先停止它: A search is already running; stop it first
快照是过去的状态，不能核对内容: A snapshot shows the past: its contents cannot be checked
执行删除前把要删的和保留的再完整读一遍（默认只核对文件没有变过）: Before deleting, read both the copy to delete and the copy kept again in full (by default only checks that the files did not change)
扫描还没有完成，完成后才能查找重复文件: The scan has not finished; duplicate files can be searched once it has
把所有打开的扫描放在一起比较（默认只比较当前扫描）: Compare all open scans together (by default only the current scan)
有 {count} 组保留的那份也在删除篮里，执行时这些组跳过: In {count} groups the copy kept is in the delete basket too; those groups are skipped
有只差大小写的同名项，打开的可能是另一个: Another item's name differs only in case; opening it might reach that one
本组保留的那份已在删除篮里: The copy kept of this group is already in the delete basket
查找在核对它之前停止了: The search stopped before checking it
查找重复文件时的磁盘负载上限；同一块盘上有扫描时先等扫描结束: Disk load ceiling of duplicate searches; a scan on the same disk goes first
核对 {c} · 被别人改了 {m} · 保留不了 {u}: checked {c} · changed by others {m} · could not keep {u}
核对之后这个文件变过，没有动: This file changed after it was checked; it was left alone
核对期间文件变了: The file changed while it was checked
每个卷至少留一份: At least one copy stays on each volume
每组保留一份（{rule}）· 在重复文件面板里查看: One copy of each group stays ({rule}) · see the duplicate files panel
每组留下哪一份（可以在面板里逐组改）: Which copy of each group stays (change it per group in the panel)
比它小的文件不比较（越小要打开的文件越多）: Smaller files are not compared (the smaller, the more files to open)
程序需要或受保护: Needed by a program or protected
系统不让保留访问时间，没有读: The system does not allow keeping the access time; not read
网络盘上的文件可能是同一个文件，只保留不删除: Files on network drives may be the same file; they are only kept, never deleted
网络盘上认不出同一个文件，这些文件只会保留: On network drives the same file cannot be recognised; such files are only kept
跨盘时每个卷至少留一份: Across drives, keep at least one copy per volume
跨盘的副本常常是有意的备份：别的卷上的那份默认不选: Copies on other drives are often deliberate backups: they are not selected by default
这一组保留的那份也在要删的东西里，没有动: The copy kept of this group is among the things being deleted; it was left alone
这个卷能共享数据块，没能查到哪些副本共享：实际腾出的可能更少: This volume can share data blocks and which copies share them could not be found: less may be freed
这个界面不支持查找重复文件: This interface does not support duplicate searches
这个视图不属于这次查找的扫描: This view does not belong to a scan of this search
把多余的副本加入删除篮: Put the extra copies in the delete basket
这个扫描还没有查找重复文件: No duplicate search for this scan yet
在网络盘或 FUSE 挂载上（默认不比较：ID 不可靠，读云盘会触发下载）: On a network drive or FUSE mount (not compared by default: file ids are unreliable there, and reading a cloud drive downloads it)
查找中途出错，可以再查一次（详情见日志）: The search stopped on an error. You can search again (details in the log)
查找中途出错，已核对的 {groups} 组保留，可以再查一次（详情见日志）: The search stopped on an error. The {groups} groups already verified are kept; you can search again (details in the log)
